prompt: A broker ran out of memory answering CommandGetTopicsOfNamespace for a namespace with a very large number of topics. Where is the memory that topic-list responses hold in flight bounded, on the broker (for both GetTopicsOfNamespace and topic-list watches) and on the proxy? Name the files and the classes or methods involved, with paths relative to the repository root, and the configuration settings that size the limits.
key: From PIP-442 (pip/pip-442.md, added 2025-09-18). The limiter: AsyncDualMemoryLimiter, with AsyncDualMemoryLimiterImpl and AsyncDualMemoryLimiterUtil (acquireDirectMemoryPermitsAndWriteAndFlush) in pulsar-common/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/common/semaphore/, holding separate heap and direct memory pools with queued, time-limited permit acquisition; TopicListMemoryLimiter (pulsar-broker-common/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/topiclistlimit/TopicListMemoryLimiter.java) extends it with metrics and estimateTopicListSize. Broker: BrokerService creates the one limiter (getMaxTopicListInFlightLimiter); ServerCnx.handleGetTopicsOfNamespace (pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/service/ServerCnx.java) acquires heap permits with an initial estimate and updates them to the list's real size; TopicListService (same package) does the same for CommandWatchTopicList; PulsarCommandSenderImpl acquires direct-memory permits before writing the response. Proxy: ProxyService creates its own TopicListMemoryLimiter and LookupProxyHandler.handleGetTopicsOfNamespace (pulsar-proxy/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/proxy/server/LookupProxyHandler.java) applies it. Settings: maxTopicListInFlightHeapMemSizeMB and maxTopicListInFlightDirectMemSizeMB (default 100 each), with the ...PermitsAcquireTimeoutMillis and ...PermitsAcquireQueueSize settings, in ServiceConfiguration and ProxyConfiguration.

sources.quote: The solution introduces an `AsyncDualMemoryLimiter` that acts as a memory-aware semaphore for topic listing operations
Add memory-based flow control and backpressure for both `CommandGetTopicsOfNamespace` and `CommandWatchTopicList` commands
Proxies are also impacted for `CommandGetTopicsOfNamespace` since the request is forwarded to a broker and the response is deserialized and reserialized without limits.

rubric.criterion: Names the limiter, AsyncDualMemoryLimiter (pulsar-common, semaphore package) and TopicListMemoryLimiter (pulsar-broker-common), with separate heap and direct memory limits
Names the broker sites: ServerCnx.handleGetTopicsOfNamespace and TopicListService for watches (and may name BrokerService or PulsarCommandSenderImpl)
Names the proxy site, LookupProxyHandler (with ProxyService creating its limiter)
Names the settings maxTopicListInFlightHeapMemSizeMB and maxTopicListInFlightDirectMemSizeMB
Every path and name given exists and does what the answer says
